v.t: Alif, Lam, Meem
v.l: Alif-Lam-Mim

v.t: The revelation of the Book, without a doubt, is from the Lord of the Universe
v.l: Tanzilu Al-Kitabi La Rayba Fihi Min Rabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: Yet they say, “He made it up.” In fact, it is the Truth from your Lord, to warn a people who received no warner before you, that they may be guided
v.l: Am Yaquluna Aftarahu Bal Huwa Al-Haqqu Min Rabbika Litundhira Qawmaan Ma 'Atahum Min Nadhirin Min Qablika La`allahum Yahtaduna

v.t: God is He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, and then established Himself on the Throne. Apart from Him, you have no master and no intercessor. Will you not reflect
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma Fi Sittati 'Ayyamin Thumma Astawa `Ala Al-`Arshi Ma Lakum Min Dunihi Min Wa Liyin Wa La Shafi`in 'Afala Tatadhakkaruna

v.t: He regulates all affairs, from the heavens, to the earth. Then it ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your count
v.l: Yudabbiru Al-'Amra Mina As-Sama'i 'Ila Al-'Arđi Thumma Ya`ruju 'Ilayhi Fi Yawmin Kana Miqdaruhu 'Alfa Sanatin Mimma Ta`udduna

v.t: That is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Powerful, the Merciful
v.l: Dhalika `Alimu Al-Ghaybi Wa Ash-Shahadati Al-`Azizu Ar-Rahimu

v.t: He who perfected everything He created, and originated the creation of man from clay
v.l: Al-Ladhi 'Ahsana Kulla Shay'in Khalaqahu Wa Bada'a Khalqa Al-'Insani Min Tinin

v.t: Then made his reproduction from an extract of an insignificant fluid
v.l: Thumma Ja`ala Naslahu Min Sulalatin Min Ma'in Mahinin

v.t: Then He proportioned him, and breathed into him of His Spirit. Then He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains—but rarely do you give thanks
v.l: Thumma Sawwahu Wa Nafakha Fihi Min Ruhihi Wa Ja`ala Lakumu As-Sam`a Wa Al-'Absara Wa Al-'Af'idata Qalilaan Ma Tashkuruna

v.t: And they say, “When we are lost into the earth, shall we be in a new creation?” In fact, they deny the meeting with their Lord
v.l: Wa Qalu 'A'idha Đalalna Fi Al-'Arđi 'A'inna Lafi Khalqin Jadidin Bal Hum Biliqa'i Rabbihim Kafiruna

v.t: Say, “The angel of death put in charge of you will reclaim you. Then to your Lord you will be returned.”
v.l: Qul Yatawaffakum Malaku Al-Mawti Al-Ladhi Wukkila Bikum Thumma 'Ila Rabbikum Turja`una

v.t: If only you could see the guilty, bowing their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, we have seen and we have heard, so send us back, and we will act righteously; we are now convinced.”
v.l: Wa Law Tara 'Idhi Al-Mujrimuna Nakisu Ru'usihim `Inda Rabbihim Rabbana 'Absarna Wa Sami`na Farji`na Na`mal Salihaan 'Inna Muqinuna

v.t: Had We willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the declaration from Me will come true: “I will fill Hell with jinn and humans, altogether.”
v.l: Wa Law Shi'na La'atayna Kulla Nafsin Hudaha Wa Lakin Haqqa Al-Qawlu Minni La'amla'anna Jahannama Mina Al-Jinnati Wa An-Nasi 'Ajma`ina

v.t: So taste, because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours; We have forgotten you; so taste the eternal torment for what you used to do
v.l: Fadhuqu Bima Nasitum Liqa'a Yawmikum Hadha 'Inna Nasinakum Wa Dhuqu `Adhaba Al-Khuldi Bima Kuntum Ta`maluna

v.t: They believe in Our communications, those who, when reminded of them, fall down prostrate, and glorify their Lord with praise, and are not proud
v.l: Innama Yu'uminu Bi'ayatina Al-Ladhina 'Idha Dhukkiru Biha Kharru Sujjadaan Wa Sabbahu Bihamdi Rabbihim Wa Hum La Yastakbiruna

v.t: Their sides shun their beds, as they pray to their Lord, out of reverence and hope; and from Our provisions to them, they give
v.l: Tatajafa Junubuhum `Ani Al-Mađaji`i Yad`una Rabbahum Khawfaan Wa Tama`aan Wa Mimma Razaqnahum Yunfiquna

v.t: No soul knows what eye’s delight awaits them—a reward for what they used to do
v.l: Fala Ta`lamu Nafsun Ma 'Ukhfiya Lahum Min Qurrati 'A`yunin Jaza'an Bima Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: Is someone who is faithful like someone who is a sinner? They are not equal
v.l: Afaman Kana Mu'uminaan Kaman Kana Fasiqaan La Yastawuna

v.t: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them are the Gardens of Shelter—hospitality for what they used to do
v.l: Amma Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Falahum Jannatu Al-Ma'wa Nuzulaan Bima Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: But as for those who transgressed, their shelter is the Fire. Every time they try to get out of it, they will be brought back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the suffering of the Fire which you used to deny.”
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Ladhina Fasaqu Fama'wahumu An-Naru Kullama 'Aradu 'An Yakhruju Minha 'U`idu Fiha Wa Qila Lahum Dhuqu `Adhaba An-Nari Al-Ladhi Kuntum Bihi Tukadhibuna

v.t: We will make them taste the lesser torment, prior to the greater torment, so that they may return
v.l: Wa Lanudhiqannahum Mina Al-`Adhabi Al-'Adna Duna Al-`Adhabi Al-'Akbari La`allahum Yarji`una
w: And surely, We will let them taste

v.t: Who is more wrong than he, who, when reminded of his Lord’s revelations, turns away from them? We will certainly wreak vengeance upon the criminals
v.l: Wa Man 'Azlamu Mimman Dhukkira Bi'ayati Rabbihi Thumma 'A`rađa `Anha 'Inna Mina Al-Mujrimina Muntaqimuna

v.t: We gave Moses the Book; so do not be in doubt regarding His encounter; and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Al-Kitaba Fala Takun Fi Miryatin Min Liqa'ihi Wa Ja`alnahu Hudaan Libani 'Isra'ila

v.t: And We appointed leaders from among them, guiding by Our command, as long as they persevered and were certain of Our communications
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Minhum 'A'immatan Yahduna Bi'amrina Lamma Sabaru Wa Kanu Bi'ayatina Yuqinuna

v.t: Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they had disputed
v.l: Inna Rabbaka Huwa Yafsilu Baynahum Yawma Al-Qiyamati Fima Kanu Fihi Yakhtalifuna

v.t: Is it not a lesson for them, how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose habitations they walk? Surely in that are signs. Do they not hear
v.l: Awalam Yahdi Lahum Kam 'Ahlakna Min Qablihim Mina Al-Quruni Yamshuna Fi Masakinihim 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin 'Afala Yasma`una

v.t: Do they not see how We conduct the water to a dry land, and with it We produce vegetation, from which their livestock eat, and themselves? Do they not see
v.l: Awalam Yaraw 'Anna Nasuqu Al-Ma'a 'Ila Al-'Arđi Al-Juruzi Fanukhriju Bihi Zar`aan Ta'kulu Minhu 'An`amuhum Wa 'Anfusuhum 'Afala Yubsiruna

v.t: And they say, “When is this victory, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Mata Hadha Al-Fathu 'In Kuntum Sadiqina

v.t: Say, “On the day of victory, the faith of those who disbelieved will be of no avail to them, and they will not be granted respite.”
v.l: Qul Yawma Al-Fathi La Yanfa`u Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'Imanuhum Wa La Hum Yunzaruna

v.t: So turn away from them, and wait. They too are waiting
v.l: Fa'a`riđ `Anhum Wa Antazir 'Innahum Muntaziruna
